newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Conglomerate Rogers raises Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Conglomerate Rogers raises Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index SEMDEX gained 1.03 points to 356.47 on Monday, helped by a rise in the shares of conglomerate Rogers, bourse officials said.
They said turnover stood at 4.18 million rupees from 8.67 million ruppes on Friday.
Rogers gained a rupee to 96 rupees on 11,029 shares while fellow conglomerate Ireland Blyth Limited was unchanged at 15 rupees on 500 shares. Rogers rose two rupees on Friday.
Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged at 50 rupees on 1,050 shares, New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 27 rupees on 1,525 shares and Sun Resorts remained at 43 rupees but was not quoted.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 86 rupees on 1,902 shares and State Bank of Mauritius edged 10 cents up to 12.10 rupees but was not quoted.
British American Insurance rose 10 cents to 8.45 rupees on 66.681 shares and Swan fell 80 cents to 45 rupees but was not quoted.
In the sugar sector, Mon Desert Alma was 2.50 rupees lower at 65 rupees on 900 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 38 rupees on 31,027 shares.

Investment stocks Mauritius Development Investment Trust gained 10 cents to 6.70 rupees on 5,500 shares. Fincorp rose four rupees to 69 rupees on 150 shares and United Docks was stable at 36 rupees on 2,000 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius rose 20 cents to 35.20 rupees but was not quoted.
